item.title: Gen Kellogg says NATO allies are 'cowards,' calls for new defense alliance
item.summary: Retired Lt. Gen. Keith Kellogg argues NATO has been ineffective during the Iran conflict, suggesting America may need new defense alignments with Japan and Australia.

item.title: Buying a home just got more expensive as the Iran war drives up mortgage rates
item.summary: Mortgage rates hit a six-month high of 6.38% as the Iran conflict stokes inflation fears, pushing homeownership further out of reach for many Americans.

item.title: Arizona girl last seen walking to stable before vanishing found alive decades later, authorities say
item.summary: Christina Plante, who vanished from Star Valley, Arizona, at age 13 in 1994, has been found alive after 32 years, closing a decades-old cold case.

item.title: FBI warns some foreign apps could collect Americans’ data — even if you never download them
item.summary: The FBI warns that foreign-developed apps, particularly those tied to China, may collect personal data even if someone never download the apps themselves.

item.title: World’s oldest known land animal alive after viral death hoax fools thousands
item.summary: Jonathan the giant tortoise is still alive after a viral April Fools' hoax on X falsely claimed the world's oldest land animal had died at age 193. Here are details.

item.title: Schumer, Jeffries sue Trump, accuse him of trying to 'rig' mail-in voting
item.summary: Congressional Democrats sue to block Trump's sweeping election order, arguing it overrides states' authority and risks disenfranchising millions of voters.

item.title: Pam Bondi already fired as attorney general, Cabinet official teed up as replacement: sources
item.summary: President Donald Trump reportedly fired Attorney General Pam Bondi and is considering replacing her with EPA Director Lee Zeldin, sources familiar with the matter say.

item.title: Country singer Tanner Usrey arrested on fentanyl possession and DWI charges in Texas
item.summary: Rising country artist Tanner Usrey faces felony drug possession and DWI charges after his arrest in Texas. He was released on a $12,500 bond.

item.title: Prince Harry’s flirty ‘sugar’ and ‘mwah’ messages to journalist surface in privacy lawsuit
item.summary: Flirty messages between Prince Harry and a Mail on Sunday journalist surfaced in his High Court privacy case, which a royal expert says could hurt his credibility.

item.title: New weight-loss pill hits the market, promising 'greater flexibility'
item.summary: FDA approves Foundayo, a once-daily weight loss pill by Lilly. Clinical trials showed adults lost an average of 27.3 pounds on the highest dose, although there are side effects.
